premises.text: UnifyID builds a unique digital fingerprint from biometric and behavioral factors across phone, computer, wearables, and nearby devices for implicit authentication without conscious user action

premises.text: Proprietary ML over 100+ attributes (e.g. gait, typing) distinguishes the real human cross-device when sensor signals match
premises.evidence_span: over 100 different attributes that go into our proprietary machine learning system that automatically discovers what makes you unique
